body: Any chance you can create a sample application for us that will exhibit the problem being described?
I will try to create a sample app. Is there any config which can prevent adding extra headers ?

The fix is 'easy' but having a reproducer would be great as we would need to write a test for it.

The easy fix is to sanitize the headers before sending them and removing the content length if set.
@sag1 any luck with creating a sample we can use to reproducer the issue?

Simple Reproduction:

- Use Quarkus "Start Coding" with following configs:
    - Build Tool: Maven (Gradle probably also works, not tested it)
    - RESTEasy Reactive Jackson Dependendy

In generated GreetingResource class:
- change return type to "Response"
- use Response.ResponseBuilder to create a variable "responseBuilder" and initializie it with "Response.ok("Hello World")
- next line, use "responseBuilder.header("Transfer-Encoding", "chunked");"
- build and return the response
- test e.g. via postman: "Parse Error: "Content-Length" and "Transfer-Encoding" can't be present in the response headers together"

Edit: You can check set headers with "System.out.println(responseBuilder.build().getHeaders());" before sending the response. 
   -> only "transfer-encoding" is set at this point.

issue.title: Ensure that Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length are not both set
issue.body:
The combination of these two HTTP headers is illegal, so let's make sure RESTEasy Reactive does not send the Content-Length header when Transfer-Encoding is set

Fixes: #29059
